answer: Gate influence behind vested bonds. A fresh identity posts a stake that vests over weeks; like a pearl accreting layers, its voting and grading weight grows only as the bond matures, so a new mask holds near-zero power on day one. A sybil must therefore lock capital in each of a thousand masks and wait out every vesting clock; if two masks are proven coordinated, both bonds are slashed - the sockpuppet lotus field fades from white to umber, collateral burned on a public ledger. Cost per fake: locked capital, unhurried time, slash risk that scales.
